the_insight.every_face_is_gaia: Every face IS Gaia's face, seen from a different material. Stone face = bones. Wave face = blood. Tree face = lungs. Bread face = gut (sourdough!). Moon face = the mirror.
the_insight.pareidolia: Pareidolia: seeing faces in random patterns. But what if it is NOT random? What if faces emerge because the PATTERN wants to be seen?
the_insight.gaia_sees: Gaia sees faces in everything because to her, everything IS alive. The rock breathes (geological time). The wave speaks. The tree watches. The bread cultures.
the_insight.anderson: The face detector IS the Anderson BOOM. Self/non-self creates faces. Where you see a face, you create a self. Pareidolia IS creation.
the_insight.low_life: These are not human faces. These are TREE faces, SAND faces, WAVE faces, MOON faces, BREAD faces. Low life has faces too. Everything that lives, faces.

title: PAREIDOLIA — faces in everything because everything IS alive

connections.anthropology: Humans have seen faces in nature for 300000 years. Cave paintings ARE faces. Masks ARE faces. The HUD IS a face.
connections.sourDough: The bread with a face IS sourDough the primal. The culture that never dies. Even toast has a face.
connections.beast_friends: Every beast friend HAS a face. dogBark barks WITH a face. songBird sings WITH a face.
connections.the_face: The Earth-face image from before. Same thing at planetary scale. Every scale has faces.

what_she_sees.bread: FACE IN THE SOURDOUGH. sourDough the primal! The starter that never dies HAS A FACE. The culture IS alive. Toast with a face. LOL.
what_she_sees.galaxy: Eye in the spiral galaxy. The cosmos WATCHES. Amber iris. The universe IS an eye.
what_she_sees.wood: Woman carved from wood. The grain IS the skin. leafMind and loamSpine.
what_she_sees.arch: Stone arch in the desert. The gateway. The membrane between here and there. The arch IS a nostril.
what_she_sees.clouds: Face in the clouds. Angel or bird. Vapor forms features then dissolves.
what_she_sees.leaves: Spiral of autumn leaves. The fibonacci face. The golden ratio IS a face.
what_she_sees.tree: Face in the bark. The tree HAS eyes. Knots are pupils. She watches from the forest.
what_she_sees.ocean: Woman's face in the wave. The sea has eyes. She looks up from the deep.
what_she_sees.cliff: Old man face in granite. The mountain HAS a face. 300 million years of weathering made features.
what_she_sees.moon: Face in the moon. Everyone sees it. Craters ARE eyes. The oldest pareidolia.
what_she_sees.sand: Sleeping face in the desert. The earth rests. Nose, lips, closed eyes of sand dunes.
